architecture: A 60 Hz simulator integrates continuous pen motion on a bounded paper plane, with circle, heart, or square reference curves and persistent vector strokes. GPT supplies held controls at 5 Hz; forward_step and turn_deg cap travel and rotation per decision, without grid snapping or teleportation.
reward_rules:
- Reward newly covered target arc length within tolerance.
- Penalize off-target ink, redundant retracing, boundary contact, and elapsed time.
- On finish, reward balanced coverage and stroke precision plus closed-loop accuracy; penalize premature completion.
- Compute coverage geometrically, not from pixels; pen-up movement earns no drawing reward.
viz_layers: Circle, heart, or square reference outline
Persistent ink strokes and live stroke tip
Pen position, heading, and pen-up indicator
ui_layout: Central WebGL canvas; left target/reset controls; right observations and reward breakdown; bottom run/pause, speed, and timeline.
